phase_name: Close the two dormant audit-gap fixtures and record the audit

objectives.description: Re-run audit sweep over core/scripts/tests/, classify each suite
Add task-lookup-lib.sh to both explicit lib loops in test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh
Add lib/task-lookup-lib.sh to REQUIRED_SCRIPTS in test-git-commit-scoped.sh + chmod skip-guard
Re-run both suites, confirm remain green

notes.audit_sweep_method: grep -lE 'task-lock\.sh|skill-base\.sh|update-task-status\.sh' over agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/*.sh, then manual multi-line-tolerant inspection (grep -n against REQUIRED_LIBS/REQUIRED_SCRIPTS/cp/source patterns, then Read of each hit's surrounding lines) of every candidate to classify it.
notes.candidates_found_note: 23 files match the grep, one of which (test-postflight-deploy-gate.sh) is the Phase 1 primary target rather than an item-(d) audit find; excluding it gives 22 audit candidates, matching the research report's predicted count exactly.

bucket_definitions.wholesale_copy_safe: Fixture copies lib/*.sh wholesale (or the whole scripts/ tree via cp -r) from the source-store/deploy tree -- immune by construction to a new unconditional source in task-lock.sh.
bucket_definitions.explicit_list_already_complete: Fixture builds an explicit lib list that already includes task-lookup-lib.sh.
bucket_definitions.no_fixture_copy: Suite sources the real skill-base.sh (or equivalent) directly from its real location (source store or deployed tree) with no synthetic minimal script tree built, so no explicit lib list exists to be missing an entry.
bucket_definitions.static_analysis_only: Suite never executes the real task-lock.sh/skill-base.sh/update-task-status.sh chain -- it either builds a synthetic fixture file purely for lint-predicate testing, or checks via bash -n / structural grep only, per the suite's own header comment.
bucket_definitions.genuine_gap_fixed: Fixture built an explicit lib list omitting task-lookup-lib.sh, while also copying task-lock.sh -- the same latent gap as the Phase 1 target. Both were dormant (still green pre-fix), not red, matching the research report's finding.

notes.verification: Both test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh (8 passed, 0 failed) and test-git-commit-scoped.sh (7 passed, 0 failed) remained green after the fix -- confirming the gaps were dormant, not red, as research predicted.
notes.file_scope_deviation: test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh and test-git-commit-scoped.sh were outside this task's original file_scope (declared at task creation before the item-(d) audit ran). Per the dispatch's item (d) instruction to fix any gap found, and per state-management.md (file_scope is descriptive, not filesystem-validated), both paths were appended to specs/state.json's file_scope array for task 206 via jq (append, not replacement).
